blocks.title: Primary source
blocks.text: Primary source asal mawad hai jo badla nahi gaya.
Tehqeeq karne wale scientists ka likha research paper primary source hai; kisi aur ka likha us ka khulasa secondary source hai.

blocks.prompt: Nayi tehqeeq par akhbar ki report primary hai ya secondary source?
blocks.explanation: Secondary, kyunke yeh asal paper ka khulasa hai.

items: Primary sources asal; secondary sources un ka khulasa.
